mostWorthwhile.text: The failed clinic call was the strongest moment: working radios still depended on a corporate directory, exposing a dependency the green light missed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Loading the settings onto the handset and then applying them to the rack felt like a fairly mechanical two-step repair, especially with only one combination offered each time.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the radio link to exchange packets while the handset still couldn't find the clinic; the missing signpost analogy clarified why.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the single-option sequence left little room for meaningful choices after the failure.

continue.text: Yes. The hidden directory dependency and the concrete offline rehearsal made me curious about how the neighborhood's network will hold up beyond the test.
